dedupe_keys.name: australia s terrestrial human industrial footprint and ecological intactness maps

description: This Zenodo dataset gives a Human Industrial Footprint index map and an Ecological Intactness Index map for Australia, circa 2020 to 2024. The footprint sums 16 nationally relevant pressure layers, each scaled from 0 to 10: intensive land uses, buildings, mining and quarrying, population density, croplands, pastures, forestry plantations, reservoirs and large dams, farm dams, roads, railways, energy transmission lines, oil pipelines, gas pipelines, hiking trails and navigable waterways. The intactness index is derived from the footprint and responds to habitat area, fragmentation and quality. Coverage is continental Australia on a 100 m grid in the Australian Albers Equal Area projection (EPSG:3577). Access is free on Zenodo (version of 11 November 2025) under CC BY 4.0. The files are GeoTIFF rasters in 7z archives of about 3.5 GB for the maps and 2.9 GB for the pressure layers, plus validation samples and the GRASS GIS pipeline script that rebuilds the index. Caveats: the pressure scores are relative expert weights, the maps are a single recent epoch, and earlier Zenodo versions exist. For simulation the pressure layers give national grids of mines, dams, pipelines, power lines, roads and railways for exposure overlays, and the intactness map supports environmental impact screening of infrastructure. Related catalogue records include Geoscience Australia OZMIN and the Australian National Pollutant Inventory.
